'''Jiro''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and a member of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang]]. He was captain of a [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]].

==Biography==
During the years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Jiro was one of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate crew]],<ref name="Revival" /> a group that would never be characterized as trusting. They could be counted on to follow their own greed, and this was how Hondo kept them under control.<ref name=":0" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date Legends">{{TCWdates|501}}</ref> as as one of Hondo's [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]],<ref>{{SWE|groups|weequaypirates|Weequay pirates}}</ref> he raided a [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|cargo ship]], the [[ALC-9]], that contained [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. As Jiro and his men were searching the ship for valuable goods, the brothers revealed themselves, [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force-choking]] Jiro. The Sith then told Jiro to betray [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and help them form an [[Army/Legends|army]], promising that they would not kill him and that he would be [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|well-rewarded]]. Jiro agreed, and Maul explained to Ohnaka that three of his lieutenants had defected against him, along with others that Jiro himself recruited. Jiro was somewhat unsettled by the execution of a pirate who was reluctant to join Maul's cause, but remained by Maul's side.<ref name="Revival" />

Subsequently, Jiro and the pirates who had followed him engaged Ohnaka's forces in an [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|attack on his former superior's base]], during which Opress murdered Jedi Councilor [[Adi Gallia]] and Ohnaka's loyalists were forced to retreat. However, Ohnaka was able to sway the loyalties of Jiro and the other pirates once more, after which recombined pirate army pursued Maul and Opress, with Jiro himself shooting and destroying one of Maul's cybernetic legs. After another pirate shot down the brother's ship, Jiro helped to salvage valuables that had survived the crash and reported that there was no sign of Maul or Opress in the wreckage, leading Hondo to believe that they had been vaporized.<ref name="Revival" />

==Personality and traits==
Jiro was greedy and cunning, and loved credits. Though initially loyal to Hondo, his loyalty was flimsy at best, and he agreed to betray his boss at the prospect of immeasurable riches. However, Hondo solidified Jiro's loyalty to him by refusing to kill him even after his treachery,<ref name="Revival" /> by appealing to their boundless greed.<ref name=":0">{{SWE|characters|jiro|Jiro}}</ref> Jiro repaid this by attempting to kill Maul on Hondo's behalf.<ref name="Revival" />

Jiro was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]<ref name="Revival" /> 1.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name=":0" /> with a mohawk hairstyle and was handy with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Revival"/>
